## Screenshots

<!--
Show the change when it's visible: the shell, panels, menus, notifications, themes, configs, a newly installed app, or anything else on screen. It makes the PR much faster to review. CI flags PRs that touch the shell, configs, themes, or package lists when this section is empty.

- Before and after screenshots of the changed UI.
- A short recording when motion, timing, transitions, or interaction are part of the change.

Drag images and videos into this box so GitHub hosts them, or link to where they're hosted. Never commit PR-only screenshots or recordings to the repo.

If nothing on screen changes, one line is enough:
No visible change: <why, e.g. "refactors the battery service; the panel renders the same">
-->
